name: Cortex Tissue Mapping (Native Space) - Myelin Mapping (T1w/T2w ratio) (No SNR masking)
summary: Maps a T1w/T2w ratio myelin map onto a FreeSurfer-derived cortical midthickness surface in native space with Connectome Workbench, without SNR masking, as a cortexmap.
description: Builds GIFTI surfaces from FreeSurfer and samples the T1w/T2w myelin map within the cortical ribbon onto the midthickness surface, following Fukutomi et al. (2018). Unlike the SNR variant, no DWI is needed and no vertices are masked. Surfaces are produced in native space only. Requires a FreeSurfer license.

inputs.description: FreeSurfer recon-all output directory of the same subject; the white and pial surfaces, ribbon.mgz, brain.finalsurfs.mgz and the chosen .annot parcellation are read from it.
T1w/T2w ratio myelin map volume aligned with the FreeSurfer anatomy, mapped to the cortical surface.
Optional existing cortexmap; the mapping script of this branch does not read the cortexmap config key, so it is effectively ignored.

outputs.description: cortexmap with the myelin map mapped to the surface in func/, plus the GIFTI surfaces in surf/ and parcellation labels in label/.
Intermediate derivatives (measure volumes, ribbon masks, SNR images, c_ras transform) kept for QA and debugging.

parameters.description: FreeSurfer surface parcellation (.annot) converted to GIFTI label files and written to the cortexmap label folder.

citations.text: Fukutomi H, et al. Neurite imaging reveals microstructural variations in human cerebral cortical gray matter. NeuroImage (2018).
Glasser MF, Sotiropoulos SN, Wilson JA, et al. The minimal preprocessing pipelines for the Human Connectome Project. NeuroImage 80:105-124 (2013).
